title: Round-Number Crossing Response

stages_inside_the_same_experiment: P1 discovery across the three symbols
conditional P2-P4 confirmation of the one P1-selected direction

research_height.transfer_path: An exogenous decimal price lattice can concentrate latent limit and stop orders at the micro level; a broad true-grid response across three indices can supply one later shared-account high-turnover entry question.

selection_card.central_question: Do crossings of economically salient round-number grids produce a broad, cost-positive thirty-minute continuation or reversion response beyond an interleaved half-grid placebo across US30, US100 and US500?
selection_card.mechanism: Order clustering at salient round prices can create either a barrier/rejection effect before and around a level or a positive-feedback stop cascade after the level is crossed. The actual decimal lattice is fixed independently of past return direction, while the half-grid lattice is a deterministic within-path placebo.
selection_card.decision_if_true: Retain exactly one non-automatic later full shared-account prototype question using the P1-selected direction and the unchanged grid/horizon/window contract. Unit 094 itself creates no trading EA or Live candidate.
selection_card.decision_if_false: Close the entire round-number crossing axis and preserve the six-component forward baseline without another level, grid, band, horizon, session, direction, symbol or subgroup rescue.
selection_card.decision_if_invalid: Preserve the baseline and make no economic statement. Correct demonstrable implementation defects inside Unit 094 without a numeric cap, but do not alter the economic contract.

literature_basis.source: Niederhoffer, Clustering of Stock Prices, Operations Research 13(2), 1965
literature_basis.role: Direct stock-market evidence that limit and stop orders cluster at familiar round numbers.

literature_basis.source: Osler, Currency Orders and Exchange-Rate Dynamics, Federal Reserve Bank of New York Staff Report 125, 2001
literature_basis.role: Direct order-level evidence that stop-loss and take-profit orders cluster at round numbers and can create different price dynamics.

literature_basis.source: Osler, Stop-Loss Orders and Price Cascades in Currency Markets, Federal Reserve Bank of New York Staff Report 150, 2002
literature_basis.role: Mechanism for positive-feedback price cascades after clustered stop orders are activated.

literature_basis.source: Sonnemans, Price clustering and natural resistance points in the Dutch stock market: A natural experiment, European Economic Review 50(8), 2006
literature_basis.role: Equity-market evidence that round-number clustering can produce natural resistance points.

whole_map_comparison.program_1: Selected despite recent concentration because the true decimal lattice and interleaved placebo create a new order-clustering role, not a breadth, cross-relative, residual, momentum, reversal, range, shock or external-state rescue. Unit 093 changes neither this level mechanism nor its data role.
whole_map_comparison.program_2: Recent VIX, participation, gold-yen, CFTC, options-expiration and Federal Reserve state units are null, ambiguous or invalid; another external state has neither coverage priority nor greater perspective distance.
whole_map_comparison.program_3: Activity/variance clocks are too close to Unit 078's expressly closed business-time alternative; price-discovery and liquidity-resiliency hypotheses need order-book or independent lead-market evidence not present in the current authoritative data.
whole_map_comparison.program_4: Bayesian drift-survival and jump exits have literature support but require a new fitted latent-state contract or overlap prior adverse-path, hold, business-time and stop boundaries. No bounded fit-free direct management question is ready.
whole_map_comparison.program_5: Expected-shortfall, CDaR and distributionally robust allocation require a newly synchronized joint-loss scenario contract and ambiguity choices, while existing concentration, drawdown, sizing, slot and counterfactual boundaries supply no ready action.
whole_map_comparison.program_7: No new causal-meta result presently changes a portfolio decision; another attrition summary would only restate the existing observation boundary.
whole_map_comparison.after_close: Recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 and all heights. Do not automatically open a round-number prototype or any adjacent lattice variant.

distance_from_closed_work.unit_027_to_038: Those fresh observers tested dynamic shock, session, flow, variance, path-efficiency, close-location and acceleration features. Unit 094 uses a fixed exogenous decimal lattice and a simultaneously observed half-grid placebo.
distance_from_closed_work.unit_053: Monthly range boundaries are rolling historical extrema with sparse upper/lower breaks; Unit 094 levels are deterministic price coordinates, reset only by calendar day for duplicate control, and are evaluated at tick crossings.
distance_from_closed_work.unit_076: Three-index dispersion was a predecision cross-sectional regime and book allocation diagnosis; Unit 094 is single-symbol local order clustering with no cross-series state.
distance_from_closed_work.unit_091: Cash breadth used prior-session ETF composition and book rotation; Unit 094 uses no external instrument or book treatment.
distance_from_closed_work.unit_093: Cross-relative convergence used a 120-H1 residual z-score, fixed 17:00 entry and two-hour hold in a shared portfolio. Unit 094 uses no peer return, z-score, fixed entry minute or shared-account admission and cannot rescue either appended member.

current_verified_tick_environment_refere.use_limit: Availability reference only. Unit 094 must freeze and prove its own dedicated runtime and before/after path fingerprints.

fixed_market_contract.price: Executable bid/ask with mid=(bid+ask)/2 only for detecting a strict crossing between consecutive valid ticks.
fixed_market_contract.eligible_server_window: 12:00:00 inclusive through 17:00:00 exclusive on each day with at least one valid tick in that window.
fixed_market_contract.crossing: An UP event requires previous mid < level and current mid >= level; a DOWN event requires previous mid > level and current mid <= level. ROUND uses integer grid multiples and PLACEBO uses the exact half-grid offset.
fixed_market_contract.duplicate_control: Within each symbol/server-date/lattice/level/direction cell, retain only the first crossing. Reset the seen-level set only on the next server date.
fixed_market_contract.large_tick_move: For each lattice retain only the first crossed level nearest the previous mid. The same executable tick may legitimately create one ROUND and one PLACEBO observation; this is recorded, not filtered after outcome.
fixed_market_contract.response_horizon: The first valid executable tick at or after 30 elapsed server minutes from the crossing tick.
fixed_market_contract.costs: Observed executable bid/ask entry and exit plus a doubled-spread book that adds one additional observed entry spread and one additional observed exit spread. No commission, swap, slippage estimate or report net is imputed.
fixed_market_contract.overlap: Concurrent observations are retained independently. No outcome from one event arms, cancels or changes another event.

P4_ISOLATED_LATEST_2026_JUN_JUL.role: latest two completed months; veto only

execution_matrix.model: MT5 Model=4 / Every tick based on real ticks
execution_matrix.period: M1 chart; every tick is processed and the response is elapsed-time based

requirements: Declaration, policy, baseline, Unit 093 and environment-reference pins remain exact.
The self-contained source/configuration, compile receipt and dedicated-runtime receipt are committed and pushed before P1 starts.
MetaEditor build 6140 reports 0 errors and 0 warnings and one EX5 hash remains fixed for every path.
Each executed path uses Model=4, reports 100 percent real ticks, stops normally and has zero detailed real-tick generation fallback, observer row, rate, tick, nonfinite or OrderCalcProfit fault.

Source/configuration and the path's symbol database, exercised tick-history and full symbol-contract fingerprint remain equal before and after each path. Any drift discards the entire incomplete Unit 094 matrix without economic use and restarts from P1 US30 after a new freeze.

Every observation has one unique symbol/date/lattice/level/direction key, one valid resolve tick at least 30 minutes after trigger, nonnegative entry/exit spreads and finite continuation/reversion observed and doubled-spread economics.

For each executed symbol-period cell, ROUND and PLACEBO each contain at least 20 resolved events and at least 10 eligible server dates. P1 additionally requires at least 50 ROUND and 50 PLACEBO events per symbol.
Unresolved observations are zero because last triggers are cut off before the path end.

per_direction_requirements: Pooled ROUND doubled-spread net is strictly positive.

Pooled ROUND mean doubled-spread net minus PLACEBO mean doubled-spread net is at least the pooled ROUND mean extra-spread cost unit, where cost unit equals observed net minus doubled-spread net for the same book.
ROUND-minus-PLACEBO mean doubled-spread net is positive in at least two of three symbols and no symbol is below negative one of its own ROUND mean cost units.
ROUND events average at least 3.0 per eligible server day across the three symbols, with zero-crossing eligible days retained in the denominator.
No symbol contributes more than 60 percent of ROUND events or more than 70 percent of positive ROUND doubled-spread net.
P1_direction_selection.selection_rule: If exactly one direction passes, select it for the unchanged P2-P4 confirmation. If both pass, select the direction with the larger pooled ROUND-minus-PLACEBO mean doubled-spread net, then the larger ROUND doubled-spread net, then CONTINUATION. If neither passes, close after P1 with no confirmation paths.
P1_direction_selection.unselected_direction: Closed inside Unit 094 at discovery and never reopened or used to rescue confirmation.

fixed_confirmation_gate.applies_to: Only the single P1-selected direction under unchanged source and observation contract.
requirements: Pooled ROUND doubled-spread net is positive in P2, P3 and P4 separately.
ROUND-minus-PLACEBO mean doubled-spread net is positive in P2, P3 and P4 separately and is at least one-half of the corresponding ROUND mean extra-spread cost unit in P2 and P3.
The ROUND-minus-PLACEBO difference is positive in at least two of three symbols in both P2 and P3 and in the pooled P4 latest period.
ROUND crossings average at least 3.0 per eligible server day across the three symbols in each of P2, P3 and P4.
Across P1-P3, no symbol contributes more than 60 percent of ROUND events or more than 70 percent of positive ROUND doubled-spread net.
P4 is a veto only and cannot select a direction, grid, symbol, threshold, window or horizon.

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_ROUND_NUMBER_CROSSING_RESPONSE_RETAIN_ONE_LATER_SHARED_ACCOUNT_PROTOTYPE_QUESTION when P1 selects one direction and every P2-P4 confirmation requirement passes.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_discovery: NO_ROUND_NUMBER_CROSSING_DIRECTION_SELECTED_CLOSE_AXIS when integrity passes but no direction passes P1.
fixed_verdict_rules.falsified: NO_ROUND_NUMBER_CROSSING_RESPONSE_CONFIRMED_CLOSE_AXIS when P1 selects a direction but any fixed confirmation requirement fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_ROUND_NUMBER_CROSSING_RESPONSE_MATRIX_NO_VERDICT when the frozen source, tick quality, fingerprint, topology or density contract genuinely cannot be satisfied.

implementation_correction_governance.rule: Correct and record demonstrable compile, parser, invocation, serialization, runtime-copy or deterministic aggregation defects as internal Unit 094 audit events. They do not create research units.
implementation_correction_governance.partial_matrix_rule: A correction or fingerprint drift after any path discards every path in the incomplete matrix without using its economic result, refreezes the unchanged contract and restarts at P1 US30.
implementation_correction_governance.valid_stage_rule: After a complete valid P1 discovery judgment, do not rerun or reinterpret P1. After a complete valid confirmation matrix, do not rerun a symbol, period or direction selectively.

approach bands, touch-without-crossing, close-location, level age, repeated-crossing count, distance, speed, volume, spread, volatility, session, weekday, month, news or direction subgroup
response horizons other than 30 elapsed minutes or any trailing, stop, target, hold extension, position sizing, risk, slot, priority or admission change
a one-symbol candidate, dropping a weak symbol, changing the P1-selected direction, or using P4 latest to select
orders, positions, broker/account queries, Program 6, Live source, package, settings, state, logs, dashboard or canonical research-ledger reads
automatic prototype, confirmation beyond P4, promotion or Live action
stop_rules: Commit and push this declaration and state boundary before the one-time source/runtime copy.
Commit and push the source, configuration, compile and dedicated-runtime freeze before P1 US30.
Run P1 US30, US100 and US500 serially; inspect only integrity needed to proceed, then perform the one fixed discovery aggregation.
If no direction passes P1, close the experiment without P2-P4. If one direction is selected, commit and push the discovery decision before P2 starts, then run all nine confirmation paths serially.
Do not open a grid, offset, band, horizon, clock, level, symbol, direction, cost, event or subgroup rescue.
Do not modify the forward baseline, lab/mt5, Live or Program 6 and do not read the Live canonical research ledgers.
